channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Explosive Odds - Supporter Pack
item.description: The Explosive Odds Supporter Pack provides a few extra costumes. If you like the game and you like us and you want to give us more money here's your chance! Comes with two Pig Bot hats and the test hat!

item.title: FlyKnight Enhanced Edition
item.description: Explore, fight, loot and fish! Solo or in co-op mode in this Old School First Person Dungeon Crawler. Earn your knighthood as you oppose the evil witch Lunamoth and stop her curse which prevents everyone from growing wings.

item.title: Stranded with You
item.description: In this survival game, you are stranded on an tropical island with your lovely friend Mitsuki. Explore your surroundings together, build a small shelter, and hunt for supplies. Have fun keeping up with all the heat!

item.title: Decklings
item.description: Tame magical creatures called Decklings and lead them into challenging battles in this resource management, deckbuilding card game. Explore wild biomes, gather resources, and craft items to build your base and raise your Decklings as you shape your path to become the Deckling Champion.

item.title: Lunar Drifter
item.description: Lunar Drifter is an Arcade First Person Shooter, your mission is to tear, blast, and crush an entire legion as fast as possible within the time limit. Featuring 4 playable characters with their own gimmicks and arsenal, more than 15 unique hand-crafted levels, and includes online Co-Op!
